relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN - report loudly. The seeded id was faddeev_kashaev1994 (Faddeev-Kashaev, 'Quantum dilogarithm', Mod. Phys. Lett. A, arXiv:hep-th/9310070). This document is arXiv:1712.04887v3 [math.NT], 'Bloch groups, algebraic K-theory, units, and Nahm's conjecture', by Calegari, Garoufalidis and Zagier, revised 6 Apr 2021. Different authors, different subject, wrong decade. This is one of FOUR uploads in this slice all seeded to the same faddeev_kashaev1994 key (the others being 2109.04664v4, 2305.14884v2 and 9601025v2); none of them is hep-th/9310070, so the seeding evidently matched on the phrase 'quantum dilogarithm' appearing in each abstract. No registered key matches: grep of folio/schema/references.ts for '1712.04887', 'Calegari' and 'Nahm' returns nothing. Set id to null. Verdict undetermined: the identification is settled, but relevance for THIS paper has not been assessed - I read only its title page and abstract, and it inherited a slot earned by a different document. It is plainly in-scope subject matter (cyclic quantum dilogarithm, Bloch group, K_3, quantum modularity of the Kashaev invariant, Nahm sums at roots of unity), so it deserves a genuine first-pass triage rather than a guessed verdict.

proposedActions.rationale: The document is unregistered and on-topic for the Bloch-group / cyclic-dilogarithm / quantum-modularity front. Register it under its own key before any citation, then triage it properly.
